summary: Iter5 full e2e validation (backend + frontend). Backend tests confirm Signal now has tp_hits (dict tp1/tp2/tp3:bool), sl_hit (bool) and max_favorable (float|null). Sticky behaviour verified across 3s-apart polls: MFE monotonic in signal direction, tp_hits never un-stick, sl_hit never un-stick, and tp_hits are consistent with MFE. Recommendation payload still exposes label/headline/take/take_label/take_reason/probability for inline rendering. Frontend Dashboard renders ActiveSignalCard with EVERYTHING inline (no separate recommendation-banner). Inline rec, take-recommendation/take-label/take-reason, tp-1..3, stop-loss-box and voice-quick-toggle all present inside active-signal-card. No JS errors on load. Legacy RecommendationBanner.jsx file still exists in src but is no longer imported/used by Dashboard (dead code).

critical_code_review_comments: Sticky logic in api_active_signal correctly uses max_favorable (MFE) instead of current price so tp_hits remain True after retracement — matches spec.

max_favorable initializes to entry on first poll (prev_mfe = cur.get('max_favorable') or entry) which is correct since entry is the first 'favorable' reference point. Note: the field is not set inside _make_signal itself, so the raw /signal/active first response after a fresh signal returns max_favorable = price.price (after max/min with entry), which is fine.
sl_hit uses price.price (current price), not MFE/worst excursion — this is correct because SL is a hard trigger and can only be hit by actual adverse price, not by reverse-excursion tracking.

Frontend ActiveSignalCard renders TP badge with emerald colors even for SELL signals (the hit/ALCANZADO badge background is hardcoded bg-emerald-500/40 in both BUY and SELL variants). Minor visual inconsistency — for SELL signals the reached-TP badge still appears green. Low priority.
RecommendationBanner.jsx file is orphaned (no imports) but still has data-testid='recommendation-banner'. Deletion recommended to avoid future confusion.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests rely on live TradingView data; a real BUY signal on 5m was active during testing (price 4608, confidence 52%, MEDIA prob).
